sql: SELECT a.sentiment, countIf(a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS tujuh_hari_terakhir, countIf(a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) AND a.timestamp < subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS tujuh_hari_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY a.sentiment

question: omset 30 hari terakhir per produk
sql: SELECT produk, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY produk ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: list deal won minggu ini yg nilainya di atas 300.000
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfWeek(today(), 1) AND d.value > 300000

question: Total menit call per sentimen bulan ini.
sql: SELECT a.sentiment, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi_menit FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY a.sentiment ORDER BY total_durasi_menit DESC

question: urutkan tipe aktivitas berdasarkan rata2 durasi tahun ini
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi_menit FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY rata_durasi_menit DESC

question: Hitung jumlah dan total nilai deal yang dibuat tiap bulan di tahun 2025.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE toYear(d.created_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Berapa rata-rata umur (hari) tiket yang masih terbuka per prioritas?
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(avg(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY rata_umur_hari DESC

question: siapa rep dengan omset tertinggi kuartal ini?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 1

question: Jumlah deal won per minggu selama kuartal ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(d.closed_date, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Berapa hari rata-rata sejak deal aktif terakhir kali diupdate?
sql: SELECT round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.updated_at, now())), 2) AS rata_hari_sejak_update FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: rekap tiket kemarin per prioritas dan status
sql: SELECT t.priority, t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE toDate(t.created_at) = yesterday() GROUP BY t.priority, t.status ORDER BY t.priority, t.status

question: Berapa persen pertumbuhan omset bulan lalu dibanding bulan sebelumnya?
sql: SELECT round((sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) - sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)))) / sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1))), 2) AS rasio_pertumbuhan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 2)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Bandingkan omset YTD dengan periode yang sama tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND (d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) OR d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1))

question: win rate per bulan per team sales, 6 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan, r.team ORDER BY bulan, r.team

question: Rata-rata jarak hari dari pelanggan mendaftar sampai deal-nya won, per segmen, untuk deal won tahun ini.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(dateDiff('day', c.created_at, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rata_hari

question: Rekap omset per bulan per wilayah pelanggan sepanjang tahun ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, wilayah ORDER BY bulan, wilayah

question: rekap mingguan 12 minggu terakhir: total tiket, jumlah yg urgent, dan rata2 waktu resolusi
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS total_tiket, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS tiket_urgent, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_resolusi_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 12) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Per bulan pendaftaran tahun ini, berapa pelanggan baru, berapa yang sudah churn, dan rasio churn-nya?
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churn, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Rata-rata lama closing (hari) per produk untuk deal won tahun ini.
sql: SELECT produk, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY produk ORDER BY rata_hari_closing

question: 5 rep dengan aktivitas terbanyak minggu lalu, tampilkan nama dan team
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfWeek(today(), 1) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC LIMIT 5

question: Bandingkan jumlah aktivitas per tipe antara kuartal ini dan kuartal lalu.
sql: SELECT a.type, countIf(a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS kuartal_ini, countIf(a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS kuartal_lalu FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY a.type

question: Omset bulan ini dari pelanggan Enterprise per rep, lengkap dengan wilayah sales-nya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.region ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: tiket terbuka yg umurnya udah lebih dari 14 hari, rekap per segmen pelanggan + rata2 umurnya
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.created_at < subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per rep per bulan selama kuartal ini, tampilkan nama rep.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi_menit FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY bulan, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan, rata_durasi_menit DESC

question: Distribusi lama closing deal won tahun ini: berapa yang 7 hari atau kurang, 8-30 hari, dan lebih dari 30 hari?
sql: SELECT countIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) <= 7) AS maks_7_hari, countIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) BETWEEN 8 AND 30) AS hari_8_30, countIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) > 30) AS lebih_30_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: Per bulan pembuatan tahun ini: jumlah deal dibuat, berapa yang masih di pipeline, dan nilai pipeline-nya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal, countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_pipeline, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS nilai_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Tampilkan omset per kuartal per segmen untuk tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal, c.segment ORDER BY kuartal, c.segment

question: jam paling sibuk utk demo dan meeting 90 hari terakhir, per tipe
sql: SELECT a.type, toHour(a.timestamp) AS jam, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type IN ('demo','meeting') AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY a.type, jam ORDER BY a.type, jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Untuk deal yang dibuat bulan ini, berapa aktivitas per tipe yang terjadi dalam 7 hari setelah deal dibuat dengan pelanggan yang sama?
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN activities AS a ON d.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) AND a.timestamp >= d.created_date AND a.timestamp < d.created_date + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Hitung tiket per prioritas yang dibuat dalam 30 hari setelah deal pelanggannya won, untuk deal won tahun ini.
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON d.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND t.created_at >= d.closed_date AND t.created_at < d.closed_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Rep mana yang punya deal aktif mandek (dibuat lebih dari 60 hari lalu dan tidak diupdate 30 hari terakhir) dengan total nilai lebih dari 5.000.000?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date < subtractDays(now(), 60) AND d.updated_at < subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING total_nilai > 5000000 ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Persentase deal yang closing di bulan yang sama dengan bulan pembuatannya, per bulan pembuatan tahun ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, round(countIf(toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) = toStartOfMonth(d.created_date)) / count(), 2) AS rasio_closing_sebulan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: list pelanggan churn yg aktivitas terakhirnya udah lebih dari 90 hari lalu
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN activities AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING aktivitas_terakhir < subtractDays(now(), 90)

question: Bandingkan omset bulan ini dan bulan lalu untuk setiap rep di wilayah sales EMEA.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND r.region = 'EMEA' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY omset_bulan_ini DESC

question: Rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket per tier pelanggan per kuartal tahun ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(t.created_at) AS kuartal, c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_resolusi_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal, tier ORDER BY kuartal, tier

question: berapa pelanggan unik yg dihubungi per minggu per tipe aktivitas bulan ini?
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, a.type, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan_unik FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY minggu, a.type ORDER BY minggu, a.type

question: Rasio sentimen negatif per bulan per tipe aktivitas sepanjang tahun ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, a.type, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, a.type ORDER BY bulan, a.type

question: Total omset dan rata-rata nilai deal won berdasarkan hari closing dalam seminggu (Senin-Minggu) tahun ini.
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(d.closed_date) AS hari, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY hari ORDER BY hari

question: Untuk deal yang dibuat bulan ini, berapa jam sampai aktivitas pertama dengan pelanggannya setelah deal dibuat? Tampilkan 10 yang paling lama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, dateDiff('hour', d.created_date, min(a.timestamp)) AS jam_ke_aktivitas_pertama FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN activities AS a ON d.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) AND a.timestamp >= d.created_date GROUP BY d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date ORDER BY jam_ke_aktivitas_pertama DESC LIMIT 10

question: forecast per bulan pembuatan per team, utk deal yg dibuat 6 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, r.team, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan, r.team ORDER BY bulan, r.team

question: Bandingkan jumlah pelanggan baru per segmen tahun ini dengan periode yang sama tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS baru_ytd, countIf(c.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS baru_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND (c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) OR c.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Tampilkan deal won kuartal ini dengan siklus penjualan lebih dari 90 hari, beserta nama rep dan perusahaan pelanggan.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, r.name AS rep_name, c.company, dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) AS lama_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) AND dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) > 90

question: Rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket per bulan untuk pelanggan aktif segmen Enterprise dalam 6 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_resolusi_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: rekap per minggu kuartal ini per prioritas: total tiket sama yg masih terbuka
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, t.priority, count() AS total_tiket, countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY minggu, t.priority ORDER BY minggu, t.priority

question: Untuk setiap bulan tahun ini, hitung jumlah aktivitas, jumlah rep unik yang aktif, dan rata-rata aktivitas per rep.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, uniqExact(a.rep_id) AS rep_aktif, round(count() / uniqExact(a.rep_id), 2) AS rata_aktivitas_per_rep FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Omset harian 7 hari terakhir per wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT toDate(d.closed_date) AS tanggal, r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 7) GROUP BY tanggal, r.region ORDER BY tanggal, r.region

question: Nilai deal won vs lost per bulan per segmen untuk kuartal ini.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, c.segment, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS nilai_won, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY bulan, c.segment ORDER BY bulan, c.segment

question: Per jam pembuatan tiket dalam 30 hari terakhir, bandingkan jumlah tiket urgent dengan tiket prioritas lain.
sql: SELECT toHour(t.created_at) AS jam, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS tiket_urgent, countIf(t.priority != 'urgent') AS tiket_lain FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY jam ORDER BY jam

question: Berapa pelanggan baru bulan lalu yang sudah punya deal, dan berapa total nilai deal mereka?
sql: SELECT uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai_deal FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Per rep: jumlah meeting bulan ini, bulan lalu, dan selisihnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS meeting_bulan_ini, countIf(a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS meeting_bulan_lalu, meeting_bulan_ini - meeting_bulan_lalu AS selisih FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY selisih DESC

question: Rata-rata durasi call per wilayah sales per minggu dalam 4 minggu terakhir.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, r.region, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi_menit FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 4) GROUP BY minggu, r.region ORDER BY minggu, r.region

question: deal aktif yg udah lebih dari 180 hari sejak dibuat, rekap per segmen + rata2 umurnya
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_deal, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date < subtractDays(now(), 180) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Untuk tiket bulan lalu, berapa rasio yang diselesaikan dalam 24 jam per prioritas?
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(countIf(t.resolution_time_hours <= 24) / count(), 2) AS rasio_selesai_24_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: Omset per bulan tahun ini dibandingkan dengan bulan yang sama tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT toMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sumIf(d.value, toYear(d.closed_date) = toYear(today())) AS omset_tahun_ini, sumIf(d.value, toYear(d.closed_date) = toYear(today()) - 1) AS omset_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Hitung win rate kuartal ini vs kuartal lalu per wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT r.region, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) / countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())), 2) AS win_rate_kuartal_ini, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())) / countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())), 2) AS win_rate_kuartal_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY r.region

question: Siapa 10 pelanggan dengan total durasi aktivitas terbanyak dalam 30 hari terakhir dan kapan aktivitas terakhirnya?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi_menit, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_durasi_menit DESC LIMIT 10
